description: Defines ASN.1 related structures and classes for UL-DCCH message types in 5G NR RRC protocol, including choice structures for different message variants and sequence definitions.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of UL-DCCH message types, with methods to set, get, pack, unpack, and serialize the message type.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_s
classes.description: Sequence structure representing the UL-DCCH message containing a message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type to a specific variant.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.
